All coordinates below are local logical 512x512 coordinates; preserve these proportions at larger output size. There must be transparent padding, fixed camera and fixed scale across cells. Do not enlarge poses to fill their cells. The action is gravity-driven watery separation from its mother pool, NOT teleporting, scale growth or a reversed death. A broad continuous curved watery neck joins its upper-left back to outlet (64,96). Clear single continuous mass, sagging from the pool, no face, feet or head curl yet. The narrowest neck is 5-8px wide near (156,203), unambiguously still connected. No face/feet. Bottom-left KEY C: the neck has pinched completely apart. One entirely separate heavy rounded teal drop falls toward (300,345), roughly155 wide and175 high, bottom abouty435. A little drawn pointed remnant at outlet(64,96) has retracted to less than20px. A large clear transparent gap separates outlet and falling drop. Drop tip points up-left toward former attachment, no face, no feet, no water trail across gap. Bottom-right KEY D: the landed water mass is squashed low on floor y448, spans x204..424, top abouty340, single opaque teal mass with mint top reflection. Two small curved closed eyelids appear on its upper front, no open eyes or mouth, no detached splashes or separate puddle rim. It will next rise into image2's canonical character at the same floor. Paint complete new silhouettes, attachments and exposed surfaces for each key, not transformed cutouts. Same volume, palette, upper-left light and outline weight. No labels, text, numbers, panel borders, background, floor line, shadows, sparkles, foam, mouth, extra limbs, blur, transparent ghosts.
